whats_detected: License Plates, Vehicles, any large object motion that passes in front of the camera lens (triggering the motion-activated camera).
whats_not_detected: There is no Facial Recognition technology (people, gender, race, etc.) used.
acceptable_use_policy: Data is used for law enforcement purposes only. Data is owned by Henrico Police and is never sold to third parties. Images captured by Flock Safety are deleted entirely after 21 days of capture in accordance with Virginia State Law.
prohibited_uses: Any purpose other than law enforcement, usage based solely on a protected class (i.e. race, sex, religion), personal use, interference with any individual engaged in a lawful activity including lawfully protected speech.
access_policy: All system access is limited to (i) persons trained in the Flock Safety system, and (ii) active criminal investigation of suspected violations of state or local law, or (iii) active investigations into missing or endangered persons, persons related to human trafficking, or (iv) receipt of notifications related to stolen vehicles, stolen license plates, missing / endangered persons, or persons related to human trafficking.
hotlist_policy: No action resulting solely from a hotlist hit is taken until the hit has been verified by Henrico Police personnel, and no license plate will be added to a hotlist unless it is connected with an active investigation or criminal warrant.
overview: The Henrico County Police Division uses Flock Safety technology to capture objective evidence without compromising individual privacy. Henrico Police use retroactive searches to solve crimes after they have occurred. Additionally, Henrico Police utilize real-time alerting of hotlist vehicles and wanted persons status to recover or capture suspected criminals. This technology is also used to locate missing/endangered persons or persons associated with human trafficking. Henrico Police maintain compliance with Virginia State Law (2.2-5517). In an effort to ensure that proper usage and guardrails are in place, we have made the policies and usage statistics below available to the public.
